entities.summary: Our Lady of La Vang is a Roman Catholic title of the Blessed Virgin Mary associated with a purported Marian apparition during the persecution of Christians in Vietnam. The namesake shrine is located today in Hải Lăng District of Quảng Trị Province in Central Vietnam. Basilica of Our Lady of La Vang is a minor basilica in Asia, established in 1928. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
